newsitem.title: UK: Regal makes cash call to fund hotels buy.
newsitem.headline: Regal makes cash call to fund hotels buy.

text.p: Regal Hotel Group Plc said on Friday that it plans to raise 36.6 million stg through a placing and open offer of new and convertible shares and to raise another 35 million via a debenture stock issue.

The company said in a statement that the proceeds of the placing and open offer and issue of new debenture stock would be used to fund its acquisition of 13 three star hotels from brewer-to-leisure group Whitbread Plc for 64.5 million stg in cash.
Regal is placing 48.47 million new ordinary shares at 54p per share and 8.68 million new convertible preference shares at 120p per share, it said.
The ordinary offer is on the basis of one new share for every existing five shares and four new shares for every 11 existing convertible preference shares.
It is offering four new convertible preference shares for every 15 existing convertible preference shares.
It will also issue 35 million stg of nominal nine percent debenture stock 2006.
The purchase from Whitbread increases Regal's network to 95 UK three star hotels.
